misc: Primary organizer of the Hector Trophée event.
biography: Toni, representing the esteemed Hirsala Golf, occupies an unparalleled position within the storied history of the Hector Trophée. As a steadfast pillar of the tournament, he is set to make his fourteenth appearance at the upcoming Hector Trophée, having competed in all thirteen previous editions of this prestigious annual competition since its inception.

Beyond his exceptional longevity on the fairways, Toni is the primary organizer of the Hector Trophée event, shouldering the logistical weight that brings competitors together year after year. Yet, this behind-the-scenes dedication is remarkably matched by on-course dominance. He has triumphantly hoisted the coveted Hector Trophée on four separate occasions as part of a winning pair, while also securing the prestigious individual Victor Trophy three times, establishing a staggering legacy of excellence in both formats of the competition.

Known for a fierce competitive spirit balanced by an affable off-course demeanor, Toni approaches each iteration of the tournament with the same relentless drive that has defined his illustrious career. As he prepares for his fourteenth foray, the golf community watches with profound admiration, anticipating another masterclass from a true titan of the Hector Trophée.
